description: Defines the ILocalSiloDetails interface in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which provides properties related to details of a local silo in Orleans distributed system.

classes.name: ILocalSiloDetails
classes.description: Interface providing various properties about the local silo, including name, cluster ID, host name, and silo addresses.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Property to get the name of the silo.

methods.name: ClusterId
methods.description: Property to get the cluster identity associated with this silo.

methods.name: DnsHostName
methods.description: Property to get the DNS host name of the silo, typically obtained via System.Net.Dns.GetHostName().

methods.name: SiloAddress
methods.description: Property to get the address of this silo's inter-silo endpoint.

methods.name: GatewayAddress
methods.description: Property to get the address of this silo's gateway proxy endpoint.
